slug: 2024-06-28 Integrated National Data Exchange Systems - Uganda Case Study

facts.fact: DIAL says UGHub is in use today as Uganda's national data exchange system, serving government ministries, departments and agencies as well as private entities.
DIAL says UGHub is used by over 100 government ministries, departments and agencies as well as private entities such as banks, insurers and fintech firms.

note: No figure for exchanges or transactions through UGHub is stated, so no usage fact; as_of is the published date, the document giving no event date.
